column1: # Every row was checked against the Indonesian entry on en.wiktionary.org,
# which marks the pepet vowel explicitly: "ê" is /ə/, "é" and "è" are not.
# A rule is kept only where Wiktionary shows two readings that genuinely
# split along the two parts of speech named here.
# class is the coarse POS that selects the reading. A "-" marks a side that is
# either unverifiable, or verifiable but unsafe because the tagger mislabels
# the common sense. Either way the resolver abstains and the dictionary decides.
# tests/no-regression.test.ts keeps every rule honest against real sentences.
# mask is a hex bitmask over the word's "e"s: bit i set = the i-th "e" is /ə/.
